contract: docs/design-direction.md: static role departments with distinct figures, shared task inspection, optional Observatory and default Tasks; no walking or animation loop.

accessibility.evidence: Native task-specific roster buttons mirror figure selection and support Enter. Pressed selection, visible focus, and aria-live inspector expose state. Inspector details expose boundaries and dependencies. Stage changes work under reduced motion with no animation. Scoped review, not a complete audit.

responsive.evidence: Both views fit 1280, 1024, 390 and 320 CSS-pixel widths. The inspector sits beside the scene at 1024 and above. Narrow layouts stack the inspector and use full-width roster targets. Three palette choices and light/dark screenshots inspected.

loading.reason: No asynchronous model or connector operation exists in this static prototype.

empty.evidence: Approving the sample Builder proposal empties Needs you; its task lane displays No tasks.

error.reason: This change adds no fallible remote operations. Runtime error and retry UI remains future work.

partial.reason: Records are complete local fixtures; partial retrieval is not implemented.

success.evidence: All four Canvas hit targets and keyboard roster selection open the correct task. Views and palettes preserve selection; review stage, pause/resume and reset update shared sample state. No page errors were reported.

permission.evidence: Builder approval changes the sample task to Queued and explicitly starts no execution. Resetting sample stage retains the approval.
